K2.order-4 elements of D_N with all orbits of size 4 are exactly the rotations by +-N/4
K3.sign lift of the quarter rotation preserving C: exactly two (global sign), = +-twisted quarter translation, T^4 = -I
K3b.every access orbit of this clock is a square (cross-ratio 2): lambda = -1 without 'marks = stations'
K4.control four copies: U J = J Q and R-invariance hold, but every mixed response vanishes and K0 (homogeneity) fails
K5.control delocalised stations: after raw-side sign gauge the clock IS the quarter rotation, mixed responses non-zero, yet stations are not arcs
